title: In JetBrains Hub before 2026.2.52519 enforced two-factor authentication could be disabled via the profile update…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains Hub versions before 2026.2.52519 allows an attacker with limited privileges to disable enforced two-factor authentication via the profile update endpoint. This flaw could lead to a significant reduction in account security by bypassing multi-factor authentication requirements.
